title: Computer Science Foundations & Web Fundamentals
description: A 14-question comprehensive test covering core programming concepts, data structures, web protocols, and networking.

questions.question_text: Which data structure operates on a Last-In, First-Out (LIFO) principle?
What is the worst-case time complexity of the QuickSort algorithm?
Which layer of the OSI model is responsible for routing packets across networks?
What default port number does the secure HTTPS protocol use?
In SQL, which clause is used to filter records aggregated by a GROUP BY clause?
Which HTTP method is idempotent and used to update existing resources or create them if non-existent?
In Object-Oriented Programming, what concept allows a subclass to provide a specific implementation of a method already defined in its superclass?
What type of join in SQL returns all rows from the left table and matched rows from the right table?
Which component in a CPU performs arithmetic and logical computations?
What does CSS stand for in web development?
Which algorithm is used to find the shortest path in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights?
In JavaScript, which keyword is used to declare a variable scoped to its enclosing block that cannot be reassigned?
What protocol translates domain names (e.g., kiet.edu.pk) into IP addresses?
Which Git command creates a local copy of a remote repository?
